name: Meiping Vase with carved Dragon Motif
material: Porcelain with pale bluish-white (qingbai; 青白) glaze and carved decoration
summary: A fierce coiling dragon chasing a pearl amid mist and clouds—a symbol of fertility and power—decorates this sturdy vase.
